jobs.description:
About Us

TRC, Member of WSP, is a global consulting environmental and engineering firm and one of the top design firms in the energy sector. Together, TRC and WSP’s 83,000 experts create positive, long-lasting impacts for our communities and our clients in the power and energy, transportation and infrastructure, environmental, and property and buildings sectors. As part of our team, you’ll discover a world of opportunities to connect with innovative thinkers, forge your path, and have fun tackling the world’s most challenging projects. At TRC, Member of WSP, you can have a rewarding career on every level.

TRC has long set the bar for clients who require more than just engineering, combining science with the latest technology to devise innovative solutions that stand the test of time. From pipelines to power plants, roadways to reservoirs, schoolyards to security solutions, clients look to TRC for breakthrough thinking backed by the innovative follow-through of an industry leader.

We recognize that the expertise of our staff is our strongest asset, so we generously reward employees for successful performance and invest in their careers through training and the development of new skills and certifications.

Overview

TRC, now a member of WSP, is seeking a Survey Project Coordinator to support the successful planning, coordination, and delivery of pipeline, utility, energy, renewable energy, transportation, and infrastructure surveying projects.

Working under the direction of a Professional Land Surveyor and/or Survey Project Manager, this position coordinates communication and project information between field crews, office staff, project managers, subcontractors, and clients to help ensure projects remain organized, on schedule, and positioned for successful delivery.

The Survey Project Coordinator combines technical surveying knowledge with strong organizational and communication skills to support project execution throughout the project lifecycle.

Responsibilities

Coordinate project startup activities by organizing project documentation, field packages, schedules, and survey information under the direction of the Professional Land Surveyor or Survey Project Manager.
Support the planning, coordination, and execution of pipeline, utility, energy, renewable energy, transportation, and infrastructure surveying projects.
Coordinate communication between field crews, office personnel, project managers, subcontractors, and clients.
Assist with preparing project work packages, exhibits, maps, survey records, field information, and project deliverables.
Monitor project schedules, milestones, deliverables, and resource assignments, communicating potential issues or schedule impacts.
Process, organize, and review survey data, field notes, exhibit, plats, and other project documentation prior to technical review by a Professional Land Surveyor.
Facilitate document management, quality control processes, electronic file organization, and project record retention.
Support project reporting by tracking labor hours, budgets, schedules, and key performance metrics.
Assist with project invoicing by verifying project documentation, completed work, and billing information.
Coordinate utility requests, permits, survey records, right-of-way information, subcontractor activities, and project logistics.
Support proposal preparation, project startup, change management documentation, and project closeout activities.
Promote TRC's commitment to safety, quality, continuous improvement, and exceptional client service.

Qualifications

Minimum five years of surveying, survey project coordination, or project support experience.
Experience supporting pipeline, electric transmission and distribution, substations, renewable energy, utility, or other energy infrastructure surveying projects.
Working knowledge of boundary, topographic, construction, right-of-way, and utility surveying principles and practices.
Experience with AutoCAD Civil 3D, Trimble Business Center, Microsoft Office, and digital survey workflows.
Strong organizational, communication, and time management skills.
Ability to coordinate multiple projects, priorities, documentation, and deliverables simultaneously.
Experience coordinating field activities, schedules, resource assignments, documentation, and communication between office and field personnel.

Ledcor Technical Services has been building and servicing communication networks for customers across North America since 1979. Utilizing our broad expertise and experience, we customize solutions to best meet our client's needs. We act as a key partner for our clients by delivering exceptional quality, reliability, and safety in all that we do.

Join our team as a proactive and detail-driven Site Acquisition Coordinator, where you’ll play a key role in managing telecom operations and project performance. This hybrid role blends coordination of field operations with cost tracking and performance analysis, ensuring projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards. You will collaborate with project managers, engineers, and field teams while also interfacing with clients and stakeholders.

Apply today to become a part of the Ledcor Technical Services team and take the next step in your career!

Essential Responsibilities:

Coordinate and track all phases of assigned projects
Maintain and update project logs, QB systems, and Excel trackers to reflect real-time project status
Conduct weekly update calls and meetings with internal teams and clients
Generate and submit daily work-in-progress (WIP) reports and training summaries
Support project cost tracking, including labor, materials, vendors, subcontractors, and equipment
Assist in preparing cost reports, forecasts, and earned value metrics
Utilize tools like Excel and Power BI to generate performance and status reports
Support change management processes and ensure accurate billing and documentation
Collaborate with field managers to ensure job readiness and timely project completion
Participate in stakeholder meetings and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives

Qualifications:

One or more years of experience in site acquisition, (telecommunications experience is preferred, not required)
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel (Pivot Tables, Lookups, IF Statements, etc.)
Collaboration experience with vendors, project managers, engineers, or field teams
Experience with Cost Breakdown Structures (CBS) is preferred, not required
Power BI and SAP experience is a plus

Work Conditions:

Remote role with occasional travel to regional office in Florence, KY, (less than 10%)

Additional Information

Ledcor Technical Services (LTS) designs, builds, and maintains wireline or wireless networks that span North America and beyond. We are a proven leader and innovator in telecommunications network construction, maintenance, and service installation and repair.

Ledcor has been recognized as a Top 100 Inspiring Workplace in North America.

Our competitive total rewards package provides compensation and benefits that support your physical, mental and financial well-being. We offer exciting, challenging work with opportunities to develop your skills and knowledge.

All qualified individuals, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, Veteran status or any other identifying characteristic are encouraged to apply.
